name: Frame Window Counter
description: Measures how many 240 TPS frames each click in a macro can be shifted by while the player still survives.

max-frames.name: Max frames to check
max-frames.description: How many frames before and after each click are tested (1 to 25).

use-custom-survival.name: Use custom frame survival
use-custom-survival.description: If off, a shifted click must survive until the next original click. If on, it must survive the number of frames set below.

full-scan.name: Full scan
full-scan.description: Test every offset even after a failure. Slower, but the result file lists every offset. The window size is the same either way.

extra-export.name: Extra results export
extra-export.description: JSON is always saved (Replay reads it). This adds a second file.

analysis-budget-ms.name: Analysis time per frame (ms)
analysis-budget-ms.description: How long each rendered frame is spent simulating. Higher is faster but the game looks choppier.

skip-tps-check.name: Skip TPS check
skip-tps-check.description: Only turn this on if the mod wrongly says your TPS is not 240. Results are only valid at vanilla 240 TPS.

input-offset.name: Input frame offset
input-offset.description: Shifts when Replay and Analyze feed the macro's clicks (presses), in frames. Try -1 or 1 if clicks land early or late. Redo Analyze after changing it.

release-offset.name: Release frame offset
release-offset.description: Shifts only the button RELEASES when Replay and Analyze feed the macro, in frames. Try -1 or 1 if releases land early or late. Redo Analyze after changing it.
